items.label: AI Noise Cancelling for Clear Calls
items.value: This LEVN wireless headset with Mic for work blocks 99.9% of background noise, delivering professional-grade clarity. Whether in a busy airport, a lively co-working space, or taking calls while commuting, your voice stays crisp and clear. The one-touch mute function ensures instant privacy control, making the Bluetooth headset with Mic ideal for remote work, virtual meetings, and mobile professionals who need reliable, distraction-free communication anywhere

items.label: Long Battery Life & Hassle-Free Charging
items.value: This wireless headset with mic for work delivers up to 65 hours of power, enough to last a full week, keeping you connected through long meetings, office shifts, or cross-country trips without battery anxiety. The plug-and-play charging base offers effortless recharging, while the wireless headset with microphone built-in USB adapter slot ensures your dongle is always within reach. Stay productive without interruptions, no matter where work takes you

items.label: Dual Connectivity Options for Flexibility
items.value: The wireless headset with mic for work offers two seamless connection methods: Bluetooth 5.2 and USB dongle. Easily connect to laptops, mobile phones, and other Bluetooth devices. If your desktop lacks Bluetooth, simply use the wireless headphones with mic included USB adapter for a stable connection (only one device can be connected at a time). With a wireless range of up to 49 feet, you have the freedom to move around without sacrificing sound quality

items.label: Immersive Stereo Sound for Work & Play
items.value: Experience crystal-clear calls and stunning audio with the bluetooth headphones with Mic. Its binaural design blocks out background noise, providing superior sound for both professional calls and leisure activities. Enjoy seamless compatibility with platforms like Zoom, Microsoft Teams, WebEx, and Skype. Whether you're in a meeting or relaxing with music, this Bluetooth headset with microphone delivers exceptional sound quality for every moment

items.label: All-Day Comfort
items.value: The Bluetooth headset with mic is designed for long-lasting comfort. Soft protein leather earmuffs provide a cozy fit, perfect for all-day wear. The 270° rotatable mic offers flexibility to wear on either side, while the wireless headphones with mic adjustable headband reduce pressure on your ears and head. Ideal for all head sizes, the headband design with sling also prevents hair tangling, making it perfect for those with long hair, ensuring comfort throughout your busy day
